instruction: Fix `list_by_extension` so the extension match is case-insensitive (a .TXT file should match '.txt').
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops.py b/fileops.py
--- a/fileops.py
+++ b/fileops.py
@@ -40,7 +40,7 @@
 
 def list_by_extension(directory, extension):
     """Return filenames in ``directory`` ending with ``extension`` (sorted)."""
-    return sorted(f for f in os.listdir(directory) if f.endswith(extension))
+    return sorted(f for f in os.listdir(directory) if f.lower().endswith(extension.lower()))
